mapper.insert: insert into t_capp_ai_memory_state(user_id) values(#{userId}) on duplicate key update enabled=1
mapper.select: select enabled,revision,forget_before_id as fence from t_capp_ai_memory_state where user_id=#{userId}
select enabled,revision,forget_before_id as fence from t_capp_ai_memory_state where user_id=#{userId} for update
select memory_key as memoryKey,memory_value as `value` from t_capp_ai_memory where user_id=#{userId} order by memory_key
mapper.insert: insert into t_capp_ai_memory(user_id,memory_key,memory_value,updated_at) values(#{userId},#{key},#{value},current_timestamp(3)) on duplicate key update memory_value=#{value},updated_at=current_timestamp(3)
mapper.delete: delete from t_capp_ai_memory where user_id=#{userId} and memory_key=#{key}
mapper.select: select count(*) from t_capp_ai_run where user_id=#{userId} and status='RUNNING'
select coalesce(max(m.id),0) from t_capp_ai_message m join t_capp_ai_session s on s.id=m.session_id where s.user_id=#{userId}
select content,through_id as throughId,revision from t_capp_ai_summary where user_id=#{userId} and session_id=#{sessionId}

select m.id,m.role,m.content from t_capp_ai_message m join t_capp_ai_session s on s.id=m.session_id join t_capp_ai_run r on r.id=m.run_id where s.user_id=#{userId} and s.id=#{sessionId} and r.status='COMPLETED' and m.id > #{after} and m.id < #{before} order by m.id limit 24
mapper.insert: insert into t_capp_ai_summary(session_id,user_id,content,through_id,revision,updated_at) select id,user_id,#{content},#{through},#{revision},current_timestamp(3) from t_capp_ai_session where id=#{sessionId} and user_id=#{userId} on duplicate key update content=#{content},through_id=#{through},revision=#{revision},updated_at=current_timestamp(3)
